- Domain: Token, CommandLine, AliasTable (a type alias) and the tokenizer service; Insertion, Suggestion, GeneratorKey (newtype; for_arg, argument_key, #[cfg(test)] from_raw), ArgumentHint, CompletionPhase, CompletionResult (+ …Parts structs; take_suggestions, with_ghost, error); AnnotationKind, TokenAnnotation, ParsedCommandLine (+ Parts), CompletionError (no Display), ArgvState in argv_parser.rs; SuggestionQuery, SuggestionCandidate, FilterOptions, InsertionContext, GeneratorSlotView, CacheLookup<V>, GeneratorStep, GeneratorOutcome, ServedRequest (+ Parts), GeneratorCommand; entities CompletionSession, GeneratorSlot, GeneratorRun, GeneratorCache<V>, ParsePrefixCache, SuggestionRecency; repository RecencyRepository + InMemory; services fuzzy_matcher, suggestion_filter, suggestion_ranker, insertion_composer, suggestion_finalizer, suggestion_assembler, history_suggestions, path_template, first_token_suggestions, generator_trigger_policy, completion_request_policy, completion_result_builder; #[cfg(test)] test_fixtures.rs.

1. Helpers, appended to `mod tests` of src/engine.rs (HEAD 1278-1578). Test code only.
- Imports the test module needs on top of its own (HEAD 1280-1287) and `use super::*`: `crate::history::domain::repositories::history_repository::InMemoryHistoryRepository` and `crate::settings::domain::value_objects::setting_value::SettingValue`. `INLINE_ENABLED`, `Shell`, `Path`, `Duration`, `Instant`, `mpsc`, `Sender`, `Rc` already reach the module through `use super::*` (engine.rs imports them).
- `fn tool_spec(arg: &str) -> String`: the source of a local spec whose default export is an OBJECT: `format!("var s={{name:\"tool\",args:{{name:\"t\",{arg}}}}};export{{s as default}};")`. Never a function export: `QuickJsSpecRepository::find` then runs the CLI-version probe, which starts `tool --version` as a real process (quickjs_spec_repository.rs:108-110 and `cli_version`; recheck R10).
- `fn spec_dir(tag: &str, arg: &str) -> TempDir`: `TempDir::new(tag)`, writes `tool_spec(arg)` to `<dir>/.fig/autocomplete/build/tool.js` and an empty `<dir>/a.txt`. The buffer `./tool …` with cwd `<dir>` reaches it: `spec_location("./tool", cwd, None)` gives `SpecLocation::Local { dir: <cwd>/, name: "tool" }` (spec_locator.rs:7-31) and `spec_file` reads `<dir>/.fig/autocomplete/build/tool.js` (quickjs_spec_repository.rs:177-198). The buffer must hold at least two tokens (`./tool ` or `./tool a`): a single token holding `/` loads the Global `dotslash` spec from the real bundle (parser.rs:613-630).
- `fn ran(command: &str) -> HistoryEntry`: `HistoryEntry::new(HistoryEntryPrimitives { command: command.into(), exit_code: Some(0), ..Default::default() })`.
- `#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)] struct Reply { request: u64, generators: bool, error: bool, cursor: usize, loading: bool, rows: Vec<String>, ghost: Option<String> }` and `fn observe(c: &Completion) -> Reply` (`request: c.req`, `generators: c.phase == Phase::Generators`, `error: c.error`, `cursor: c.cursor`, `loading: c.loading`, `rows: c.items.iter().map(|i| i.first_name().to_string()).collect()`, `ghost: c.ghost.clone()`).
- Message helpers: `fn complete(id: u64, cwd: &Path, buffer: &str) -> EngineMsg` (cursor = `buffer.len()`), `fn complete_at(id: u64, cwd: &Path, buffer: &str, cursor: usize) -> EngineMsg` (both build `EngineMsg::Complete(Request { id, buffer, cursor, cwd: cwd.to_path_buf(), shell: Shell::Zsh, history_mode: false })`), `fn command_ended() -> EngineMsg`, `fn apply_settings(settings: Settings) -> EngineMsg`, `fn shutdown() -> EngineMsg`.
- `enum Then { Wait, Deliver(Vec<EngineMsg>), Stop }` and `fn stop_when(done: impl Fn(&[Reply]) -> bool + Send + 'static) -> impl FnMut(&[Reply]) -> Then + Send + 'static`.
- `fn serve(settings: Settings, history: Vec<HistoryEntry>, first: Vec<EngineMsg>, grace: Duration, react: impl FnMut(&[Reply]) -> Then + Send + 'static) -> Vec<Reply>`:
  1. `let (to_engine, from_senders) = mpsc::channel(); let inbox = Rc::new(EngineInbox::new(from_senders, to_engine.clone()));`
  2. `let runtime = Rc::new(QuickJsSpecRuntime::new(inbox.clone(), &settings).unwrap());` (an `Rc` because `parser_over` takes `&Rc<QuickJsSpecRuntime>`, HEAD 1393; do not reuse `runtime_with_inbox`, which returns a bare runtime).
  3. `let (replies, from_engine) = mpsc::channel();` and `let engine = Engine::with(replies, settings, parser_over(&runtime), SpecIndex::default(), HistoryModule::new(Rc::new(InMemoryHistoryRepository::new(history))), None);` (no state file: `run`'s final `if self.saving.load(SeqCst)` writes nothing, HEAD 450-452).
  4. send every message of `first` on `to_engine`;
  5. spawn a watcher thread that owns `from_engine`, a clone of `to_engine` and `react`. It waits with `recv_timeout`; each `Msg::Completion(c)` becomes `observe(&c)`, then `react(&replies)`: `Wait` keeps waiting, `Deliver(m)` sends `m` in order, `Stop` keeps collecting for `grace` and then sends `shutdown()`. steps.prompt:
Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-6-completion.md first. It is the Phase 6 prep: "Behaviour that must not change" (every trap, code-cited, with the ids PAR-T1..PAR-T36 for the parser), "Decisions" (Q1-Q33), "Deviations from the plan's letter", "Hand-off notes for later phases", "Test moves" and "Step briefs". The sections and ids this prompt names are binding. Then read the source-map files this prompt names, in docs/hexagonal-refactor/source-map/ (their line numbers are at af1b304). Load the skills xp-tdd, testing-standard, coding-standards and hexagonal-architecture with the Skill tool before you touch code (AGENTS.md).

Line numbers: this prompt cites phase6-start, the Phase 6 prep-docs commit, whose src/ is byte-identical to ff2db5a. Run 1 (6.0a, 6.1a-6.1c, 6.2a-6.2b) and the earlier steps of this run edited parser.rs, parser/tests.rs, engine.rs and suggest.rs after that (tokenizer paths and accessors, the wire rows, the 6.0a engine tests), so every number here is a hint: locate each site by symbol or content (grep), never by line number alone. Before you start, check with `git log --oneline -8` that the previous step's last commit is in HEAD, and that the facts listed under "Where you start" hold; if one this step relies on does not, stop and report it.

Read in phase-6-completion.md: "Behaviour that must not change" PAR-T1, PAR-T3, PAR-T4, PAR-T27; "Decisions" Q1 (the parser step owns AnnKind/Annotation/ParseResult/ParseError: 6.3a verbatim, 6.3b private), Q28 (CompletionError has no Display), Q31, Q33; "Deviations from the plan's letter" (CompletionError without Display; `no()` stays private); the parser (section "parser/tests.rs") and suggest rows of "Test moves"; this step's row of "Step briefs". Read source-map/parser.md (traps and gaps), and the `assemble`/`static_options`/`help_items` lines of source-map/suggest.md and the `compute` lines of source-map/engine.md.

Plan Phase 6 step 3 (start of "Move ArgvParser (pure) and ParsePrefixCache") and plan section 4, completion: `domain/value_objects/{token_annotation, parsed_command_line}` and `domain/completion_error.rs <- ParseError (Aborted, NoSuggestions)`. This step moves the four parse-vocabulary types into the completion domain VERBATIM and renames them to the glossary names (glossary rows `TokenAnnotation` / `AnnotationKind`, `ParsedCommandLine`; `CompletionError` gets its row in 6.7). Fields stay `pub(crate)` until 6.3b. Fitness rule 1 forbids a completion domain file naming `crate::parser`, which is why the suggest pipeline (run 3) needs these types here first.

Where you start (run 1 done):
- src/completion/mod.rs declares `application` and `domain`; domain/mod.rs declares `services` and `value_objects`; the tokenizer is in domain/services/command_line_tokenizer.rs; `Token`, `CommandLine`, `AliasTable` are in domain/value_objects/; the wire rows (`Suggestion`, `Insertion`, `GeneratorKey`, `ArgumentHint`, `CompletionPhase`, `CompletionResult`) are private VOs in domain/value_objects/; application/ holds completion_request.rs.
- parser.rs reads tokens through `tokens()`/`text()`/`raw()` and imports `CommandLine`/`substitute_token` from completion; the engine's arg key is `argument_key(arg.as_ref(), &pr.completion)` (6.2a).
- parser.rs still holds (phase6-start lines): `AnnKind` 36-44, `Annotation` 46-53, `ParseResult` 55-86, `ParseError` 88-93 + `impl From<SpecError> for ParseError` 95-104, `no` 106-108.

1. Create, each with only the moved item and the `use` lines it needs:
- src/completion/domain/completion_error.rs: `ParseError` (with the `NoSuggestions` doc comment) and its `impl From<SpecError>` become `#[derive(Debug)] pub(crate) enum CompletionError { Aborted, NoSuggestions(String) }` and `impl From<SpecError> for CompletionError`, arms unchanged and explicit (`SpecError::Aborted => Aborted`; `SpecError::Timeout | SpecError::Invalid(_) | SpecError::BundleUnavailable(_) => NoSuggestions(e.to_string())`). No Display, no std::error::Error (Q28).
- src/completion/domain/value_objects/annotation_kind.rs: `AnnKind` becomes `pub(crate) enum AnnotationKind`; derives `Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq`, the five variants (`Subcommand, Option, OptionArg, SubcommandArg, None`) and the `None` doc comment unchanged.
- src/completion/domain/value_objects/token_annotation.rs: `Annotation` becomes `pub(crate) struct TokenAnnotation { pub(crate) kind: AnnotationKind, pub(crate) text: String, pub(crate) parts: Vec<(AnnotationKind, String)> }`; derives `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq` and both doc comments unchanged.
- src/completion/domain/value_objects/parsed_command_line.rs: `ParseResult` becomes `pub(crate) struct ParsedCommandLine`, derives `Clone, Debug`, the same 17 fields in the same order with their doc comments, each `pub(crate)`, `annotations: Vec<TokenAnnotation>`. Imports from specs domain only (`Subcommand`, `Arg`, `SpecOption`, `ParserDirectives`) plus `Rc`.
- Add `pub(crate) mod completion_error;` to domain/mod.rs and `pub(crate) mod annotation_kind;`, `pub(crate) mod parsed_command_line;`, `pub(crate) mod token_annotation;` to domain/value_objects/mod.rs, keeping each mod.rs to alphabetical child `mod` lines only (fitness rule 6).

2. `fn no(msg) -> ParseError` stays a private fn in parser.rs and now returns `CompletionError` (PAR18: tests reach it through `super::*` in `generate_spec_merge`, `git_alias_directive` and the Mock).

3. Switch every importer in this commit (no shim, no `pub(crate) use` re-export):
- parser.rs: delete the moved items; `use` the four types from their new paths; `ParseError` -> `CompletionError` everywhere (`trait Host` and `JsHost` signatures, the `ParseCaches` methods, `matches!(e, ParseError::Aborted)` in parse_prefix, the explicit arms `Err(ParseError::Aborted)` / `Err(ParseError::NoSuggestions(_))` of generate_spec's cache-key match and generate match, `.map_err(ParseError::from)` in `JsHost::load` and `Parser::load_spec`); `AnnKind` -> `AnnotationKind`; the two `Annotation { .. }` literals (`ann` and `option_or_chain`'s `composite` closure) -> `TokenAnnotation { .. }` with the same fields; `ParseResult` -> `ParsedCommandLine` (`result`, `Parser::parse`, `ParseCaches::parse`). The `SpecError` import goes if nothing else in parser.rs uses it.
- parser/tests.rs: helpers only, plus four bodies. Helpers: `flags(r: &ParsedCommandLine)`, `type Callback = Box<dyn Fn(&[JsArg]) -> Result<Value, CompletionError>>`, the `impl Host for Mock` signatures, `run`'s return type. Bodies: result_fields (`AnnKind::` -> `AnnotationKind::`, `Vec<AnnKind>` -> `Vec<AnnotationKind>`), exceptions_and_first_token (`ParseError::NoSuggestions` -> `CompletionError::NoSuggestions`), is_repeatable (`use AnnKind::{Option as Op, ..}` -> `use AnnotationKind::{Option as Op, ..}`), aborts_propagate (`ParseError::Aborted` twice -> `CompletionError::Aborted`).
- suggest.rs: `use crate::parser::{AnnKind, ParseResult};` (line 5) -> two `use` lines from the completion domain; the parameter types of `static_options` (202), `assemble` (268), `help_items` (1327) and `AnnKind::` in help_items' body (1332, 1335). Tests: `use crate::parser::Annotation;` (1437) -> TokenAnnotation; `pr_for` (1442-1462) returns `ParsedCommandLine` and builds it with the same literal; the `Annotation { .. }` literals of option_chain_rewriting (1820-1824) and help_template (2497-2501) -> `TokenAnnotation { kind: AnnotationKind::.., .. }`, same values.
- engine.rs: line 11 `use crate::parser::{ParseCtx, ParseError, ParseResult, Parser};` -> `use crate::parser::{ParseCtx, Parser};` plus the two domain imports; `Current.pr: ParsedCommandLine` (320); compute's two arms (558-559) `Err(CompletionError::Aborted) => return None` and `Err(CompletionError::NoSuggestions(e)) => { logger::debug(&format!("engine: no suggestions: {e}")); .. }` unchanged otherwise; `queries(&self, pr: &ParsedCommandLine, ..)` (634); `update_slots(.., pr: &ParsedCommandLine, ..)` (672).

4. No new test: these types validate nothing (PAR17); the moved code is guarded by the existing tests.

Guards (all must stay green with no body change beyond the list below): every parser test (23 in parser/tests.rs), every suggest test (assembly_options_rules, option_chain_rewriting and help_template read the parse result), every engine test including the twelve 6.0a characterization tests (should_reply_again_with_the_split_lines_of_a_script_generator ... should_reply_an_error_without_ghost_text_for_a_cursor_inside_a_word), first_token_spec_identity_is_stable and parse_arguments_table (PAR-T27), the golden capture.

Expected CHANGED against phase6-start (first time, this step): result_fields, exceptions_and_first_token, is_repeatable, aborts_propagate (parser/tests.rs), option_chain_rewriting, help_template (suggest.rs). Each is a glossary rename of a type or variant path, nothing else. No other test may change: generate_spec_merge and git_alias_directive call `no(..)`, which keeps its name; NEW 0.

Traps (code-cited in "Behaviour that must not change"):
- PAR-T1: the warn `logger::warn(&format!("generateSpec ({}): {e:?}", tokens[0]))` (parser.rs 919, in generate_spec) prints the error's DERIVED Debug, e.g. `generateSpec (cmd): NoSuggestions("spec is not an object")`. Renaming the enum keeps that text; renaming a variant, hand-writing Debug, wrapping the String or switching to `{e}` changes it. Keep `Aborted` and `NoSuggestions(String)` exactly.
- PAR-T3 / D8: the From keeps its three explicit arms; never collapse them into `_`.
- PAR-T4: every error text stays (`no tokens`, `no {name} spec`, `cannot consume {token:?}`, `failed loading spec for ..`, `loadSpec recursion too deep`, `alias did not return a string`, `invalid alias for {token:?}`); this step touches none of the `no(..)` call sites.
- AnnotationKind has a variant named `None` (and one named `Option`): never glob-import its variants into a scope that also uses `Option::None`; parser.rs keeps writing `AnnotationKind::None` (the final-token annotation and parse_prefix's `last_type`).
- Rc identity (PAR-T27): moving the types changes no value; do not touch the arg key.

Evidence a reviewer will rerun:
- the moved-block diffs: `git show phase6-start:src/parser.rs | sed -n '36,104p'` against the four new files (only `pub` -> `pub(crate)`, the renames and `use` lines);
- `grep -rn 'AnnKind\|ParseResult\|ParseError\|\bAnnotation\b' src` prints only parser.rs's module doc line 2 (it goes with the file in 6.3e);
- testlock CHANGED (new) = exactly the six tests above;
- the local fitness run reports nothing for the four new files.

Commit: one commit, e.g. `refactor(completion): move the parse result vocabulary into the domain`.

Hands to 6.3b: `AnnotationKind`, `TokenAnnotation`, `ParsedCommandLine` (in completion/domain/value_objects/) and `CompletionError` (completion/domain/completion_error.rs) at their final paths, with `pub(crate)` fields; `no()` in parser.rs returning `CompletionError`; suggest.rs's `pr_for` still building a `ParsedCommandLine` literal.

Deviations to report: CompletionError has no Display and no std::error::Error (plan section 1 asks one per module error; only its Debug is printed, Q28/PAR6); `no()` stays a private parser fn (PAR18).

Rules for this step:
- Move code with a script (python slicing by the line ranges you located by symbol, or `git mv` for a whole file), never by retyping it. Diff every moved block against `git show phase6-start:<old file>` (the same symbol located in that revision) and, for code an earlier step of this phase already edited or moved, also against `git show HEAD:<file>` before your edit: only paths, visibility, glossary names and the edits this prompt lists may differ. Put the diff summary in your report.
- New seams are test-first (xp-tdd): RED, GREEN, commit, REFACTOR, commit (the REFACTOR commit only when there is something to tidy). New tests use should_... names that are unique crate-wide: run `grep -rn "fn <name>(" src` before you add each one (it must print nothing; testlock keys tests by fn name). AAA layout, no mocks (InMemory doubles and real objects only).
- Before every commit, run the full `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/gate.sh` (it must print GATE PASS). Then run `python3 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py . phase6-start --diff` and `python3 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py . ef807c1 --diff`, and delete `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/__pycache__`. In BOTH runs MISSING must be 0 and DUPLICATE must be 0 (the gate fails only on MISSING against ef807c1 and only prints the DUPLICATE line). Against phase6-start, every CHANGED test must be in the expected list of this step or of an earlier Phase 6 step, and must be a pure restructuring: justify each test this step changed in your report. Against ef807c1 many tests are already CHANGED by earlier phases: only MISSING and DUPLICATE count there.
- Fitness, locally, before every commit (src/completion/ exists since 6.1a; never edit REGISTERED_MODULES in the main tree): stage the commit's paths, then from the repo root `R=$PWD/target/hexagonal-refactor/review-tmp; F=$R/fit; rm -rf "$F"; mkdir -p "$F"; git archive "$(git write-tree)" | tar -x -C "$F"`, add "completion" to REGISTERED_MODULES in "$F/src/architecture_tests.rs" (the list already holds "specs"), run `(cd "$F" && CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$R/fit-target" cargo test --locked architecture)` and delete "$F". It must report no line for src/completion/domain/** or src/completion/application/**. A line for a file this step touched is a defect of this step: fix it before committing. A line for a file you did not touch: report it, do not fix it.
- Clippy allows 3 warnings and the baseline already has 3, so no new warning (unused import, unused `mut`, needless borrow, ...). Prune the imports of parser.rs, engine.rs, suggest.rs and the test modules as items leave them; never keep a production import that only a test module uses (give the test module its own `use` line instead).
- `grep -n 'cfg(windows)\|cfg(unix)\|cfg(not(\|cfg(target_os\|cfg(all(\|cfg!(' ` every file you touch. parser.rs and parser/tests.rs have none (PAR-T34); engine.rs's only one is `env_var`'s `cfg!(windows)` (both branches compile); suggest.rs has the `exe_name` cfg(unix)/cfg(not(unix)) twins and the cfg(unix) tests `list_dir_skips_control_char_names` and `first_token_sources` (until 6.2e moves them). Code under a cfg that is false on macOS is never compiled here: if you touch a file that holds one, check by hand that every path it uses still resolves on the other side.
- Commit as `refactor(completion): <why, not what>` (`test(completion): ...` for a test-only commit). Write the message to a file, measure the subject with `head -1 <file> | awk '{print length}'` (at most 72), and commit with `git commit -F <file>` (the RTK hook rewrites `-m` text). Stage explicit paths (never target/). End the message with the trailer line `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Never rewrite committed history: no `git commit --amend`, rebase, `git reset` of a commit, `filter-branch` or force. Fix forward with a new commit. A subject over 72 characters is reported, not rewritten.
- `integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped` (shell_integration's embedded_shell_scripts tests) is pty-timing flaky under the gate's parallel load. If it is the gate's only failure, rerun it alone with `cargo test --locked shell_integration::infrastructure::adapters::embedded_shell_scripts::tests::integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped -- --exact` (it must print `1 passed`), then run the full gate again. Never edit, `#[ignore]` or skip it. Any other failing test is a defect of this step.
- Never change behaviour to get green. A failing guard means your change is wrong, never the test. If you cannot keep the behaviour, stop at the last green commit and report.
- Engine loop guard: before the step's last commit, run the engine tests 20 times, `for i in $(seq 20); do cargo test --locked engine::tests -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | grep '^test result'; done`; all 20 lines must show `0 failed` (Q33). They include the twelve 6.0a characterization tests, the five session-context tests, session_update_refreshes_first_token_items and the two inbox tests.
- Before the step's last commit, run `cargo check --locked --no-default-features --all-targets` (the only build of the cfg(not(feature = "embed-specs")) branches; neither the gate nor CI runs it). It must pass.
- At the end of this step, after the last commit, run `cargo test --locked --release -- --ignored all_bundle_modules` (plan section 8; this step touches parser/engine code). It must print `1 passed`; report that line.
- Report: the commits (hash and subject), the final gate lines, both testlock summaries, every CHANGED test with its justification, every NEW test, the moved-block diff summary, every deviation (including the ones this prompt lists), and concerns for later steps.

steps.title: The parse result keeps its fields private
steps.prompt:
Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-6-completion.md first. It is the Phase 6 prep: "Behaviour that must not change" (every trap, code-cited, with the ids PAR-T1..PAR-T36 for the parser), "Decisions" (Q1-Q33), "Deviations from the plan's letter", "Hand-off notes for later phases", "Test moves" and "Step briefs". The sections and ids this prompt names are binding. Then read the source-map files this prompt names, in docs/hexagonal-refactor/source-map/ (their line numbers are at af1b304). Load the skills xp-tdd, testing-standard, coding-standards and hexagonal-architecture with the Skill tool before you touch code (AGENTS.md).

Line numbers: this prompt cites phase6-start, the Phase 6 prep-docs commit, whose src/ is byte-identical to ff2db5a. Run 1 (6.0a, 6.1a-6.1c, 6.2a-6.2b) and the earlier steps of this run edited parser.rs, parser/tests.rs, engine.rs and suggest.rs after that (tokenizer paths and accessors, the wire rows, the 6.0a engine tests), so every number here is a hint: locate each site by symbol or content (grep), never by line number alone. Before you start, check with `git log --oneline -8` that the previous step's last commit is in HEAD, and that the facts listed under "Where you start" hold; if one this step relies on does not, stop and report it.

Read in phase-6-completion.md: "Behaviour that must not change" PAR-T7, PAR-T25, PAR-T27; "Decisions" Q1, Q2 (the Parts precedent and "no positional constructor takes two usizes or bools"), Q31, Q33; "Deviations from the plan's letter" (ParsedCommandLineParts, the accessor `completion()`); the parser and suggest rows of "Test moves"; this step's row of "Step briefs". Read source-map/parser.md (trap "result L912-929", gap "Making ParsedCommandLine and TokenAnnotation fields private"), the assemble/static_options/help_items lines of source-map/suggest.md and the compute/reply lines of source-map/engine.md.

Plan Phase 6 step 3 and plan section 1 (domain struct fields private; accessors when other code reads them; precedent `HistoryEntry::new(HistoryEntryPrimitives)` of Phase 3). This step makes the two parse-result VOs private and switches every reader to accessors. It precedes the suggest pipeline (run 3), so that code is written once, against accessors.

Where you start: 6.3a's four types exist in completion/domain with `pub(crate)` fields; parser.rs, parser/tests.rs, suggest.rs and engine.rs name them.

1. src/completion/domain/value_objects/parsed_command_line.rs:
- `ParsedCommandLine`'s 17 fields become private (their doc comments stay on them).
- Add `pub(crate) struct ParsedCommandLineParts` in the same file: the same 17 fields, same names, order and types, each `pub(crate)`, with one doc line ("The fields of a ParsedCommandLine, by name"). It is plumbing (no glossary row; precedent HistoryEntryPrimitives, named Parts because the fields hold Rcs). No derives beyond what compiles, no Default.
- `pub(crate) fn new(parts: ParsedCommandLineParts) -> Self` destructures the parts into the struct: no logic. No positional constructor (clippy too_many_arguments fires above 7 and the budget is spent; four bools in a row could be swapped silently).
- One accessor per field, returning the stored value by reference or a Copy value: `completion() -> &Rc<Subcommand>`, `path() -> &Vec<Rc<Subcommand>>`, `current_arg() -> &Option<Rc<Arg>>`, `search_term() -> &str`, `suggest_subcommands()`, `suggest_options()`, `suggest_args() -> bool`, `passed_options()`, `persistent() -> &Vec<Rc<SpecOption>>`, `annotations() -> &Vec<TokenAnnotation>`, `command_index() -> usize`, `tokens() -> &Vec<String>`, `raw_last_token() -> &str`, `directives() -> &ParserDirectives`, `option_chain() -> &Option<String>`, `first_token() -> bool`, `spec_name() -> &str` (PAR5: `completion()` keeps the field's word; 6.7 adds that meaning to the glossary). No setters, no `with_*`.
2. src/completion/domain/value_objects/token_annotation.rs: private fields; `pub(crate) fn new(kind: AnnotationKind, text: String, parts: Vec<(AnnotationKind, String)>) -> Self`; `kind() -> AnnotationKind`, `text() -> &str`, `parts() -> &Vec<(AnnotationKind, String)>`. Derives unchanged.
3. parser.rs (still the legacy home of the state machine):
- `ann(kind, text)` builds `TokenAnnotation::new(kind, text.into(), Vec::new())`; `option_or_chain`'s `composite` closure pushes `TokenAnnotation::new(kind, token.into(), parts)`.
- readers: parse_prefix's `last_type` (`st.annotations.last().map_or(AnnotationKind::None, |a| a.kind())`); `result` (538-587): `a.text.clone()` -> `a.text().to_string()`, `a.parts` -> `a.parts()` (is_empty, last, the `[..len - 1]` slice).
- `result`'s `ParseResult { .. }` literal becomes `ParsedCommandLine::new(ParsedCommandLineParts { .. })` with the same field order and the same expressions.
- D8 on `result`'s `match a.parts.last()` (547): the catch-all `_ => option_chain = Some(a.text.clone())` becomes the explicit arms `Some((AnnotationKind::Subcommand | AnnotationKind::Option | AnnotationKind::SubcommandArg | AnnotationKind::None, _)) | None => option_chain = Some(a.text().to_string())`, mapping exactly as the catch-all did (the `filter(!parts.is_empty())` above it makes `None` unreachable; keep it in the arm anyway).
4. suggest.rs production: static_options (`pr.passed_options()`, `pr.completion()`, `.chain(pr.persistent())`, `pr.directives().option_arg_separators()`), assemble (`pr.completion()`, `pr.option_chain().as_deref()`, `pr.suggest_subcommands()`, `pr.suggest_args()`, `pr.current_arg()`, `pr.suggest_options()`), help_items (`pr.annotations().iter()`, `a.kind()`, `pr.path()`, `pr.path().last().unwrap_or(pr.completion())`). Tests: `pr_for(comp, search)` now returns `ParsedCommandLineParts` (same values); assembly_options_rules, option_chain_rewriting and help_template keep editing the same fields on those Parts and pass `&ParsedCommandLine::new(pr)` to `assemble`/`help_items`; their annotation literals become `TokenAnnotation::new(AnnotationKind::.., "..".into(), vec![])` with the same values. Run 3 (6.2d) moves `pr_for` into completion/domain/test_fixtures.rs with this signature.
5. engine.rs readers (compute, queries, update_slots, reply): `pr.current_arg.clone()` -> `pr.current_arg().clone()`; the arg key `argument_key(arg.as_ref(), pr.completion())`; `pr.completion().filter_strategy()`; `pr.search_term.clone()` -> `pr.search_term().to_string()` (GeneratorContext, `Query::Value`, `prev_search`, the result row); `json!(pr.search_term)` -> `json!(pr.search_term())` (the same JSON string); `pr.tokens().get(pr.command_index()..)`; `pr.first_token()`; `pr.raw_last_token()`; reply's `pr.tokens().get(pr.command_index())`, `pr.search_term()`/`pr.raw_last_token()` for the insertion context, `pr.tokens().clone()`, `pr.command_index()`, `pr.current_arg().as_ref()`. Nothing else changes.
6. parser/tests.rs: helper `flags` reads the three bool accessors; in the tests below each field read becomes its accessor, adding only what the type needs (`*` before `r.tokens()` / `parts()` / `option_chain()` in an `assert_eq!` against an array or `None`, `.as_ref().unwrap()` for `r.current_arg.unwrap()`, `ptr(r.current_arg())`, `Rc::ptr_eq(r.completion(), ..)`); never a literal, an input or an assertion.

Guards: every parser test, every suggest test, every engine test (20x, see the rules), the golden capture; the Rc-identity tests parse_arguments_table, single_token_paths, load_spec_and_is_module, recursive_load_spec, generate_spec_merge, first_token_spec_identity_is_stable and generator_keys_differ_per_index (PAR-T27); composite_option_value_raw_is_the_value_only (raw vs text).

Expected CHANGED against phase6-start, first time in this step (accessor reads only): parse_arguments_table, single_token_paths, load_spec_and_is_module, recursive_load_spec, is_command_recursion, sudo_git_command_index, generate_spec_merge, persistent_options_inherit_without_mutation, inline_and_function_load_specs, git_alias_directive, prefix_cache, cached_nested_state_keeps_this_commands_prefix, composite_option_value_raw_is_the_value_only, first_token_spec_identity_is_stable (parser/tests.rs) and assembly_options_rules (suggest.rs: Parts + `ParsedCommandLine::new`). Changed again: result_fields, exceptions_and_first_token, is_repeatable, option_chain_rewriting, help_template. Unchanged bodies (they read no result field): relative_path_first_token_loads_local_spec, options_can_break_variadic, load_spec_cycle_is_an_error, aborts_propagate, generate_spec_cache_key, spec_identity_survives_dev_reload_and_cache_clear. NEW 0.

Traps:
- PAR-T27 (plan section 7 risk): the engine's arg key hashes `Rc::as_ptr(current_arg)` and `Rc::as_ptr(completion)`. Accessors return `&Rc<_>` / `&Option<Rc<_>>`; nothing deep-clones a spec and nothing builds a new `Rc` around an accessor's value (`Rc::new((*x).clone())` would break identity silently and only the ptr tests would notice).
- PAR-T25: `result` keeps its semantics: a composite annotation always reads `opt_args`; a trailing OptionArg part sets only_args, the search term and `raw = raw_last_token.strip_prefix(flag).unwrap_or(t)`; otherwise `option_chain = Some(text)`; the last token text is `last_text`; `suggest_args` is always true.
- PAR-T7: `last_text`/`raw_last_token` still come from the original command line.
- Never reorder the Parts fields relative to the original literal's expressions: each expression is evaluated in the literal's order (`current_arg` reads `arg_st` before `annotations` moves `st.annotations` last).

Evidence a reviewer will rerun: `git diff HEAD~1 -- src/engine.rs src/suggest.rs` (production hunks) shows only accessor reads and the `json!` argument; testlock --diff shows each CHANGED body differing only by accessor calls, `*`, `.as_ref()`, the Parts wrap and `TokenAnnotation::new`; `grep -nE '\bpr\.[a-z_]+([^a-z_(]|$)' src/engine.rs src/suggest.rs` prints nothing outside the test modules (the three suggest tests still write the fields of their Parts); the local fitness run is silent for both VO files.

Commit: one commit (or two: VOs + readers, then tests, if each is green), e.g. `refactor(completion): keep the parse result fields behind accessors`.

COMMIT 2 (TDD, Q6): src/completion/domain/entities/parse_prefix_cache.rs (+ entities/mod.rs, + `pub(crate) mod entities;` in domain/mod.rs, alphabetical).

Its `load(&self, location)` = `self.specs.find(location, &self.lookup).map_err(CompletionError::from)`; `call(&self, call)` = `Ok(SpecRuntime::call(self.runtime, call, Some(self.generator), TIMEOUT)?)`; `substitute(&self, cmd, index, value)` = `substitute_token(cmd, index, value, self.shell)`. The five `impl ParseCaches` methods move into `impl ParsePass` by script, bodies verbatim except: `host.` -> `self.`, the `host` parameter dropped from every signature and call, `self.prefix.get/insert` and the MAX_CACHED clear -> `self.cache.prefix_state` / `self.cache.remember_prefix_state`, `self.generated.get/insert` and its clear -> `self.cache.generated_spec` / `self.cache.remember_generated_spec`, `self.first.clone()` -> `self.cache.first().clone()`, and the warn line -> `(self.report)(CompletionNotice::GenerateSpecFailed(format!("generateSpec ({}): {e:?}", tokens[0]))); // spec name only: logs never hold typed text` (same format string, same comment, same position before `return Ok(st)`). `cwd` and `dev` stay parameters; both `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]` stay as they are.
- D8 on apply_load_spec's final `_ => Ok(None)` (862): `Some(SpecLoadDirective::Fn(_)) | None => Ok(None)`. The P11/deviation-15 `_ => None` / `_ => Err(no("spec is not an object"))` reads of SpecFunctionResult move unchanged (PAR19).

No `pub(crate) use` re-exports.
- Tests (same commit): `impl Host for Mock` goes. Add the helper `parse_reporting(cache: &mut ParsePrefixCache, command_line: &CommandLine, cwd: &Path, dev: bool, mock: &mut Mock, report: &mut dyn FnMut(CompletionNotice)) -> Result<ParsedCommandLine, CompletionError>`: `specs = Rc::new(InMemorySpecRepository::with(<pairs of mock.specs>))`; `runtime = Rc::new(mock.fns.runtime())`; settings `Settings::default()`, plus `.with(AUTOCOMPLETE_DEVELOPER_MODE, SettingValue::Bool(true))` when `dev` (the parser now reads dev from the settings, as the engine always did); `ParseCtx { cwd, settings: &settings, env: &HashMap::new(), shell: Shell::Bash, index: &SpecIndex::default() }`; `CommandLineParser::new(specs.clone(), runtime).parse(cache, command_line, &ctx, report)`; then `mock.loads.extend(specs.finds())` WHETHER OR NOT the parse failed (tests assert loads after an Err); return the result. `parse(cache, command_line, cwd, dev, mock)` calls it with `&mut |_| {}`; `run(mock, buf)` = `parse(&mut ParsePrefixCache::default(), &cmd(buf), Path::new("/cwd"), false, mock)`. - Split spec_identity_survives_dev_reload_and_cache_clear (D6, Q20, P16):

Body lines that do not name the parser stay verbatim (runtime, TempDir "devid", the two `mk.js` sources, `settings_from_json(json!({"autocomplete.developerMode": true}) ..)`, env, index, `loc`). Replace only: the `ParseCtx` with `let generator = GeneratorContext::new(dir.path().to_string_lossy().into_owned(), env.clone(), "zsh".into(), String::new(), false);` (exactly what `gen_ctx` built for that ctx; do not use `find_mk`, whose context is the default) and `let lookup = SpecLookup::new(&settings, &index, &generator);`; `Parser::new(..)` with `let repository = QuickJsSpecRepository::new(js.clone(), EmbeddedSpecBundle::new(data_directory_from_env()));`; each `p.load_spec(&loc, &ctx)` with `repository.find(&loc, &lookup)`; `p.clear_caches(); // settings save` with `repository.forget_loaded_specs(); // settings save`; the first assertion loses only its `&& Rc::ptr_eq(&first, &p.caches.first)` term (and the `first` binding). Add the test module `use` lines it needs (`settings_from_json`, `serde_json::json`).

- Commit, e.g. `refactor(completion): parse over the spec ports instead of a Host trait`.

Guards: every parser test; git_alias_directive through the real tokenizer (PAR-T36); aborts_propagate (Aborted through the InMemory runtime, PAR-T5); generate_spec_merge, generate_spec_cache_key, inline_and_function_load_specs (typed calls through the doubles); prefix_cache and cached_nested_state_keeps_this_commands_prefix (PAR-T9/T10/T12); single_token_paths, relative_path_first_token_loads_local_spec, exceptions_and_first_token (load sequences, PAR-T35); first_token_spec_identity_is_stable and parse_arguments_table (PAR-T27); the quickjs_spec_repository tests; every engine test 20x (the facade feeds the real engine); golden.

Expected CHANGED against phase6-start: generate_spec_cache_key (first time), prefix_cache, cached_nested_state_keeps_this_commands_prefix, first_token_spec_identity_is_stable (again: the cache type and the parse helper), spec_identity_survives_dev_reload_and_cache_clear (the repository half, moved). Commit 1 changes no body. NEW (5): the two cache tests, the two notice tests, spec_identity_survives_dev_reload_and_cache_clear_first_token. MISSING 0; DUPLICATE 0 (the old spec_identity copy must be gone from parser/tests.rs).

Traps:
- PAR-T1/T2: the notice text is built in the parser with the same format string and comment, and handed out at the old moment (inside the failing generate call, before `return Ok(st)`, once per failing call, even when the parse later fails or aborts); the facade logs it at warn at once. Never collect notices and log them after the parse (lines would move after later `js console` lines).
- PAR-T5: Aborted propagates from every load, alias, loadSpec, cache-key and generate call; nothing is cached on an abort.
- PAR-T8..T11: location order, `?` on any find error, `failed loading spec for ..`, the prefix-cache key format (`texts[..len-1].join(" ")`, `loc.cache_key()`, `cwd.display()`), dev mode neither reads nor writes the prefix cache, the clear runs before the insert even for a stored key, MAX_DEPTH 64.
- PAR-T13: disableForCommands stays in `SpecRepository::find` (`SpecLookup::disables`), checked on every find through the one lookup built per parse; never a request-level rule (Phase 5 deviation 3, D1).
- PAR-T16: substitution re-tokenizes with the REQUEST's shell (`ctx.shell`), the alias value is `trim_end()`-ed, `invalid alias for {token:?}` stays.
- PAR-T19/T20: the cache-key fn gets one argument `{"tokens": tokens}`, no exec; `.filter(|_| !dev)`; key `"{tokens[0]}:{k}"`; one new Rc per uncached generate; stored only with a key.

- PAR-T31: clear_caches keeps `first`, forgets only loaded specs, in that order; the engine still calls it at the same place through the facade.
- PAR-T33: ParsePrefixCache is an exclusive `&mut`, never a RefCell; nothing calls `find` from inside a runtime callback.
- PAR-T27: a cache hit returns a clone holding the same Rcs; the `first` Rc lives in the cache and survives clear_caches.

Evidence a reviewer will rerun: `grep -rn 'trait Host\|impl Host\|JsHost\|ParseCaches\|fn load_spec(&self' src/parser.rs src/parser/tests.rs` prints nothing; the five ParsePass bodies diffed against `git show phase6-start:src/parser.rs` (the impl ParseCaches block) show only `host` removal, the cache calls, the ArgvState API of 6.3c and the notice line; `cargo test --locked -- --list 2>/dev/null | grep spec_identity` lists both halves; testlock as above; the local fitness run is silent for parse_prefix_cache.rs and completion_notice.rs.

Hands to 6.3e: `CommandLineParser { specs, runtime }` with `new`, `parse(&self, cache, cmd, ctx: &ParseCtx, report)`, `clear_caches(&self, cache)`, the private `ParsePass`, `TIMEOUT`, `MAX_DEPTH`, `dev_mode`, `gen_ctx`, `no`, `ParseCtx` and the `Parser` facade, all still in parser.rs; `ParsePrefixCache` (domain entity) and `CompletionNotice` (application DTO) at their final paths; the parser tests' `Mock`/`Functions`/`parse_reporting`/`parse`/`run` harness over the InMemory doubles.

Deviations to report: the intra-phase `Parser` facade (6.3d-6.3e only); `Parser::load_spec` deleted with its last caller (not Phase 11); D5 through the `CompletionNotice` callback; ParsePrefixCache passed `&mut` (Q6); the fixture keeps the name `Mock` (PAR11); the D6 split.

Rules for this step:
- Move code with a script (python slicing by the line ranges you located by symbol, or `git mv` for a whole file), never by retyping it. Diff every moved block against `git show phase6-start:<old file>` (the same symbol located in that revision) and, for code an earlier step of this phase already edited or moved, also against `git show HEAD:<file>` before your edit: only paths, visibility, glossary names and the edits this prompt lists may differ. Put the diff summary in your report.
- New seams are test-first (xp-tdd): RED, GREEN, commit, REFACTOR, commit (the REFACTOR commit only when there is something to tidy). New tests use should_... names that are unique crate-wide: run `grep -rn "fn <name>(" src` before you add each one (it must print nothing; testlock keys tests by fn name). AAA layout, no mocks (InMemory doubles and real objects only).
- Before every commit, run the full `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/gate.sh` (it must print GATE PASS). Then run `python3 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py . phase6-start --diff` and `python3 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py . ef807c1 --diff`, and delete `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/__pycache__`. In BOTH runs MISSING must be 0 and DUPLICATE must be 0 (the gate fails only on MISSING against ef807c1 and only prints the DUPLICATE line). Against phase6-start, every CHANGED test must be in the expected list of this step or of an earlier Phase 6 step, and must be a pure restructuring: justify each test this step changed in your report. Against ef807c1 many tests are already CHANGED by earlier phases: only MISSING and DUPLICATE count there.
- Fitness, locally, before every commit (src/completion/ exists since 6.1a; never edit REGISTERED_MODULES in the main tree): stage the commit's paths, then from the repo root `R=$PWD/target/hexagonal-refactor/review-tmp; F=$R/fit; rm -rf "$F"; mkdir -p "$F"; git archive "$(git write-tree)" | tar -x -C "$F"`, add "completion" to REGISTERED_MODULES in "$F/src/architecture_tests.rs" (the list already holds "specs"), run `(cd "$F" && CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$R/fit-target" cargo test --locked architecture)` and delete "$F". It must report no line for src/completion/domain/** or src/completion/application/**. A line for a file this step touched is a defect of this step: fix it before committing. A line for a file you did not touch: report it, do not fix it.
- Clippy allows 3 warnings and the baseline already has 3, so no new warning (unused import, unused `mut`, needless borrow, ...). Prune the imports of parser.rs, engine.rs, suggest.rs and the test modules as items leave them; never keep a production import that only a test module uses (give the test module its own `use` line instead).
- `grep -n 'cfg(windows)\|cfg(unix)\|cfg(not(\|cfg(target_os\|cfg(all(\|cfg!(' ` every file you touch. parser.rs and parser/tests.rs have none (PAR-T34); engine.rs's only one is `env_var`'s `cfg!(windows)` (both branches compile); suggest.rs has the `exe_name` cfg(unix)/cfg(not(unix)) twins and the cfg(unix) tests `list_dir_skips_control_char_names` and `first_token_sources` (until 6.2e moves them). Code under a cfg that is false on macOS is never compiled here: if you touch a file that holds one, check by hand that every path it uses still resolves on the other side.
- Commit as `refactor(completion): <why, not what>` (`test(completion): ...` for a test-only commit). Write the message to a file, measure the subject with `head -1 <file> | awk '{print length}'` (at most 72), and commit with `git commit -F <file>` (the RTK hook rewrites `-m` text). Stage explicit paths (never target/). End the message with the trailer line `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Never rewrite committed history: no `git commit --amend`, rebase, `git reset` of a commit, `filter-branch` or force. Fix forward with a new commit. A subject over 72 characters is reported, not rewritten.
- `integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped` (shell_integration's embedded_shell_scripts tests) is pty-timing flaky under the gate's parallel load. If it is the gate's only failure, rerun it alone with `cargo test --locked shell_integration::infrastructure::adapters::embedded_shell_scripts::tests::integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped -- --exact` (it must print `1 passed`), then run the full gate again. Never edit, `#[ignore]` or skip it. Any other failing test is a defect of this step.
- Never change behaviour to get green. A failing guard means your change is wrong, never the test. If you cannot keep the behaviour, stop at the last green commit and report.
- Engine loop guard: before the step's last commit, run the engine tests 20 times, `for i in $(seq 20); do cargo test --locked engine::tests -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | grep '^test result'; done`; all 20 lines must show `0 failed` (Q33). They include the twelve 6.0a characterization tests, the five session-context tests, session_update_refreshes_first_token_items and the two inbox tests.
- Before the step's last commit, run `cargo check --locked --no-default-features --all-targets` (the only build of the cfg(not(feature = "embed-specs")) branches; neither the gate nor CI runs it). It must pass.
- At the end of this step, after the last commit, run `cargo test --locked --release -- --ignored all_bundle_modules` (plan section 8; this step touches parser/engine code). It must print `1 passed`; report that line.
- Report: the commits (hash and subject), the final gate lines, both testlock summaries, every CHANGED test with its justification, every NEW test, the moved-block diff summary, every deviation (including the ones this prompt lists), and concerns for later steps.

steps.prompt:
Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-6-completion.md first. It is the Phase 6 prep: "Behaviour that must not change" (every trap, code-cited, with the ids PAR-T1..PAR-T36 for the parser), "Decisions" (Q1-Q33), "Deviations from the plan's letter", "Hand-off notes for later phases", "Test moves" and "Step briefs". Run 1 (6.0a, 6.1a-6.1c, 6.2a-6.2b) and the earlier steps of this run edited parser.rs, parser/tests.rs, engine.rs and suggest.rs after that (tokenizer paths and accessors, the wire rows, the 6.0a engine tests), so every number here is a hint: locate each site by symbol or content (grep), never by line number alone. Read in phase-6-completion.md: "Behaviour that must not change" PAR-T28..PAR-T31, PAR-T33; "Decisions" Q6, Q11 (the engine's free `log_completion_notice` until 6.6b), Q21 (parser.rs and src/parser/ leave in 6.3e), Q26 (the Settings arm order), Q31, Q33; "Deviations from the plan's letter" (ParseContext, the two 5 s TIMEOUTs); the parser rows of "Test moves"; "Hand-off notes for later phases"; this step's row of "Step briefs". Read source-map/parser.md (gap "Not placed by the plan: the Parser facade ... ParseCtx ... TIMEOUT") and source-map/engine.md (spawn, the Settings arm, compute).

Plan Phase 6 step 3 ("Move parser/tests.rs to command_line_parser/tests.rs") and step 7 (delete parser.rs and parser/tests.rs; Q21 does it here, with the file's last item); plan section 4 `application/command_line_parser.rs` (+ `command_line_parser/tests.rs`); plan section 9's Phase 5 hand-off. After this step parser.rs and src/parser/ are gone and the legacy engine owns the parser and its prefix cache (Q6: `CompletionSession` takes the cache in 6.4e).

Where you start: parser.rs holds `ParseCtx` (110-117 at phase6-start), `CommandLineParser`, the private `ParsePass`, `TIMEOUT` (33-34), `MAX_DEPTH`, `dev_mode`, `gen_ctx`, `no`, `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` and the `Parser` facade (6.3d); src/parser/tests.rs holds 23 tests on the InMemory harness. engine.rs (phase6-start): `use crate::parser::{ParseCtx, Parser};` (11, after 6.3a), spawn's `let parser = Parser::new(repository, runtime.clone());` + `Engine::new(tx, settings, parser, &dependencies)` (102-103), the field `parser: Parser` (334), `Engine::new(.., parser: Parser, ..)` (359, 373), `Engine::with(tx, settings, parser: Parser, index, history_module, state_path)` (380-418), the Settings arm `self.parser.clear_caches();` (479), compute's `ParseCtx { .. }` literal and `self.parser.parse(&cmd, &pctx)` (549-562), the module doc line 5 naming `Parser::parse`; tests: `parser_over(js: &Rc<QuickJsSpecRuntime>) -> Parser` (1392-1396), used by session_update_refreshes_first_token_items (1369), engine_with_wrapper_env (1405) and the 6.0a helper.

COMMIT 1: the parser moves to the application layer.
- Create src/completion/application/parse_context.rs: `ParseCtx` becomes `pub(crate) struct ParseContext<'a> { pub(crate) cwd: &'a Path, pub(crate) settings: &'a Settings, pub(crate) env: &'a HashMap<String, String>, pub(crate) shell: Shell, pub(crate) index: &'a SpecIndex }` (an application input: named `pub(crate)` fields, the doc comment kept).
- Create src/completion/application/command_line_parser.rs and move into it, by script: `CommandLineParser` + impl, `ParsePass` + impl, `TIMEOUT` (with its doc comment; the parser's own 5 s, never merged with the repository's copy, P14), `MAX_DEPTH`, `dev_mode`, `gen_ctx` renamed `generator_context` (module map), `no`, and `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`. `ParseCtx` -> `ParseContext` in the signatures. Production imports: std, settings domain, shared domain (`Shell`), specs domain and the `SpecRuntime` port, completion domain (`substitute_token` included) and `CompletionNotice`; no logger, no serde_json, no infrastructure, no legacy module (fitness rules 1-3; the plan's hand-off: completion never imports fig_spec_mapper in production).

Only the cache-miss branch changes: `let executables = PathExecutableCatalog.executables(path.as_deref(), pathext.as_deref());` then `first_token_suggestions::first_token_items(self.index.completions(), aliases, &executables)`. Arrange specs `["git", "aws/s3", "@scope/cli"]`, aliases `{"gst": "git status"}`, executables `["mytool", "git", "mytool"]`; assert the rows `(first(), kind, priority)` are `[("git", Subcommand, 40.0), ("@scope/cli", Subcommand, 40.0), ("gst", Shortcut, 100.0), ("mytool", Subcommand, 40.0)]` and the `gst` row's description is `Some("git status")`. New tests (grep each name first): `should_list_the_entries_it_was_given_for_a_directory`, `should_list_nothing_for_a_directory_it_was_not_given`, `should_offer_the_executables_it_was_given`, `should_count_every_scan_of_the_path`, `should_offer_spec_names_then_aliases_then_executables_each_name_once`.

Guards: `list_dir_sorted`, `list_dir_skips_control_char_names`, `first_token_sources`, `session_update_refreshes_first_token_items` and the five session-context tests in engine.rs (`should_use_the_env_of_a_session_context_in_place_of_the_wrapper_env` and the other four: their bodies must not change), the 6.0a suite, the golden capture.

Traps:
- `list_dir`: unreadable dir -> `[]` without `../` (1280-1282); `std::fs::metadata` follows symlinks (1287); `.DS_Store` skipped case-insensitively (1294); control-char names dropped (1295); dot names last, then `cmp_locale` (1297-1301); `../` appended after the sort even for an empty dir (1302); folders-only keeps `../`; `insert_value` is evaluated before `with_names(vec![n])` moves the name (1311-1320).

Hands to 6.2f: suggest.rs holds only the generator group (`triggered`, `dir_changed`, `cache_key`, `Lookup`, `CacheEntry`, `GenCache`) and the tests `triggers`, `cache_ttl_swr_max_age`, which 6.4a moves; the two ports with `InMemoryDirectoryLister` and `FixedExecutableCatalog` (for 6.4f's runner and 6.5's harness); src/completion/infrastructure exists.

Rules for this step:

Diff every moved block against `git show phase6-start:<old file>` (and against the step's start commit where runs 1-2 already edited the block) to prove that only paths, visibility, glossary names and the edits this prompt lists changed.

Then run `python3 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py . ef807c1 --diff` and `python3 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py . phase6-start --diff`: MISSING must be 0 and DUPLICATE must be 0 in both (the gate only fails on MISSING against ef807c1). Against phase6-start, every CHANGED test must be one this prompt expects or one an earlier Phase 6 step already changed, and each must be a pure restructuring that you justify in changedTests. Against ef807c1 many tests were CHANGED by earlier phases already: there only MISSING and DUPLICATE count. Delete `scripts/hexagonal-refactor/__pycache__` afterwards.

It must report no line for any file of the registered module(s). Never edit src/architecture_tests.rs in the main tree.

- Run `grep -n 'cfg(windows)\|cfg(unix)\|cfg(not(\|cfg(target_os\|cfg(all(' ` on every file you touch. Code under cfg(windows) or cfg(not(unix)) is never compiled here, and a cfg(unix)-only item imported without the same cfg breaks the Windows CI job: check by hand that every path still resolves on both sides. Stage explicit paths (never target/). End the message with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Never rewrite committed history: no `git commit --amend`, rebase, `git reset` of a commit, `filter-branch` or force. Fix forward with a new commit. A subject over 72 characters is reported, not rewritten.
- `integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped` (shell_integration's embedded_shell_scripts tests) is pty-timing flaky under the gate's parallel load. If it is the gate's only failure, rerun it alone with `cargo test --locked shell_integration::infrastructure::adapters::embedded_shell_scripts::tests::integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped -- --exact` (it must print `1 passed`), then run the full gate again. Never edit, `#[ignore]` or skip it. Any other failing test is a defect of this step.
- Never change behaviour to get green, never change what a test asserts or feeds, never weaken, delete or `#[ignore]` a test (D1-D9 bind). If you cannot keep the behaviour, stop at the last green commit and report.
- At the end of this step, after the last commit, run `cargo test --locked engine::tests -- --test-threads=1` once (the 6.0a characterization suite and the engine tests; all must pass) and `cargo test --locked --release -- --ignored all_bundle_modules` (plan section 8; it must print `1 passed`). Report both lines.
- Report: the commits (hash and subject), the final gate lines, the testlock summary lines against both baselines, every CHANGED test with its justification (changedTests), every deviation (including the ones this prompt lists), anything suspicious you noticed but did not fix, and concerns for later steps.

steps.prompt:
Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-6-completion.md first. It is the Phase 6 prep: "Behaviour that must not change" (every trap, code-cited, under its research id: SUG-, ENG-E, CON-T, GEN-GT, M1-M10), "Decisions" (Q1-Q33), "Deviations from the plan's letter", "Test moves", "Hand-off notes for later phases" and "Step briefs". The sections and decision ids this prompt names are binding: the SUG traps for `SuggestionCandidate`, `SuggestionAssembler`, `SuggestionRanker`, `SuggestionFilter`, `InsertionComposer` and `SuggestionFinalizer` in "Behaviour that must not change"; Q2 (the `Parts`/`with_*`/no-positional-bools rule, SUG16), Q28 and Q33 in "Decisions" and D7; the 6.2f rows of "Test moves" (sections 5.2 and 5.4) and the "priv" column of the value_objects rows of the module map. Then read source-map/suggest.md (traps and the gap on private fields) and source-map/engine.md in docs/hexagonal-refactor/source-map/ (their line numbers are at af1b304; read the code they cite with `git show af1b304:<file>`). Load the skills xp-tdd, testing-standard, coding-standards and hexagonal-architecture with the Skill tool before you touch code (AGENTS.md).

Line numbers: this prompt cites HEAD ff2db5a, which is the local tag phase6-start (this phase's testlock baseline). suggest.rs, pty.rs, cli.rs, types.rs, menu.rs, render.rs, icons.rs, inline.rs, main.rs and src/bootstrap/* did not change between c2f0825 (the tree the phase doc's research cites) and ff2db5a, so the phase doc's numbers for them are HEAD's. engine.rs did change (+2 lines after line 24, +12 from `EngineInbox`, +13 from `run`; the phase doc has the full map). Runs 1-2 of this phase then edited suggest.rs and engine.rs: 6.0a added 12 characterization tests to engine.rs's test module; 6.1a-6.1c moved the tokenizer (`shell_parser` is `completion::domain::services::command_line_tokenizer`); 6.2a-6.2b moved the wire rows (`Item` -> `Suggestion`, `GenKey` -> the `GeneratorKey(u64)` newtype with `for_arg`, `Insertion`, `Completion` -> `CompletionResult`, `Request` -> `CompletionRequest`) and made them private (`InsertionParts`/`SuggestionParts` constructors, accessors); 6.3a-6.3b turned `ParseResult`/`Annotation`/`AnnKind` into `ParsedCommandLine`/`TokenAnnotation`/`AnnotationKind` with private fields and accessors; 6.3e replaced parser.rs with `CommandLineParser` (engine fields `command_line_parser`, `parse_prefix_cache`). HEAD numbers are therefore a guide: locate every site by symbol or content (grep), never by number alone, and work on the code as runs 1-2 left it.

Plan Phase 6 step 2, part f (plan section 1: domain struct fields are private): the four pipeline VOs of 6.2c keep their fields private. Every reader switches to accessors, every write to a fresh row or a clone to a `with_*` builder, and the two in-place loops to four `set_*` methods. No behaviour change, no new test.

1. SuggestionCandidate (src/completion/domain/value_objects/suggestion_candidate.rs). Fields private.
- Accessors named after the fields, returning what the specs model returns (P7 precedent, e.g. `SpecSuggestion::names() -> &Vec<String>`): `names() -> &Vec<String>`, `display_name()`, `insert_value()`, `description()`, `separator()`, `template_type()`, `icon()` -> `&Option<String>`; `kind() -> SuggestionKind`; `original_kind() -> Option<SuggestionKind>`; `priority() -> f64`; `hidden()`, `is_dangerous()`, `should_add_space()` -> `bool`; `args() -> &Vec<Rc<Arg>>`; `query() -> &SuggestionQuery`; `generator() -> Option<GeneratorKey>`. Returning `&Vec` (not a slice) keeps test edits to the accessor substitution (`s.names().clone()` stays a `Vec<String>`).
- `with_<field>(mut self, v) -> Self` for writes to fresh rows or clones, only for fields something writes: production `with_kind`, `with_original_kind`, `with_names`, `with_description`, `with_insert_value`, `with_priority`; test-only `#[cfg(test)]` (D7) `with_is_dangerous`, `with_args`, `with_display_name`, `with_template_type`, `with_query`, `with_should_add_space`, `with_separator`. Find the test-only ones with a temporary `#![warn(dead_code)]` at the top of the file (main.rs allows dead code crate-wide); remove it before committing. Add no builder nothing calls.
- `set_priority`, `set_query`, `set_names`, `set_insert_value` (`&mut self`) only for the two in-place loops (SUG3), so `update_priorities` and `option_chain` keep their loop structure.
- The associated constructors `new`, `from_sub`, `from_opt`, `from_suggestion` live in the same file and keep their struct literals verbatim.
- Switch the services (locate by symbol in the 6.2d files): `update_priorities` (`s.priority = ..` -> `s.set_priority(..)`; reads through accessors); `option_chain` (`s.query = Query::Value(String::new())` -> `s.set_query(SuggestionQuery::Value(String::new()))`; the in-place rename `for n in &mut s.names { if *n == short { *n = chain.to_string(); } }` -> `let names = s.names().iter().map(|n| if *n == short { chain.to_string() } else { n.clone() }).collect(); s.set_names(names);` (the same element-wise replacement); `s.names = vec![name.clone()]; s.insert_value = Some(name);` -> `s.set_names(vec![name.clone()]); s.set_insert_value(Some(name));`); `filter`'s auto-execute row (`let mut x = s.clone(); x.kind = ..; x.original_kind = Some(s.kind); if folder { x.names = ..; x.description = .. } x.insert_value = ..` -> the same writes as `with_*` on the clone, same values, folder ones still conditional); `auto_exec`, `history_rows`, `static_options` (`s.priority = 75.0` on a fresh row -> `s = s.with_priority(75.0)`), `mix_history` (compute the fold from the clone's `names()`/`priority()`, then `with_priority`), `first_token_items`' `push` closure; every read in `filter`, `same_row`, `name_match`, `insertion`, `highlight`, `assemble`, `cmp_first`, `short_name`.
- `to_item` (suggestion_finalizer.rs) moves fields out of the candidate today (`names: s.names, ..`), which private fields forbid from another file. Build the row with the accessors and `.clone()` in the same field order: `insertion(&s, c)`, `highlight(..)`, `args_hint(s.args())` and `query` are still computed first, then `names: s.names().clone()`, `display_name: s.display_name().clone()`, `kind: s.kind()`, and so on for every field. The row's values are identical; only the move becomes a clone.
- Tests and fixtures: `names` (fixture) reads `s.kind()`.
2. FilterOptions, InsertionContext, GeneratorSlotView (one commit, or one each).
- `FilterOptions`: `#[derive(Default)]` (all false, what the `opts()` fixture builds today), private fields, accessors `fuzzy()`, `auto_exec_hidden()`, `exec_after_space()`, `run_dangerous()`, `suggest_current_token()`, and the five `with_*`. No positional constructor (five bools, SUG16). The `opts()` fixture becomes `FilterOptions::default()`.
- `InsertionContext<'a>`: `pub(crate) fn new(search_term: &'a str, raw: &'a str, shell: Shell) -> Self` with the three bools false, `with_fuzzy`, `with_prefer_verbose`, `with_insert_space`, accessors `search_term() -> &'a str`, `raw() -> &'a str` (return the stored `&'a str`, so borrows work as with the fields), `shell()`, `fuzzy()`, `prefer_verbose()`, `insert_space()`. The `ctx()` fixture becomes `InsertionContext::new(search, raw, shell).with_insert_space(true)` (it sets `insert_space: true` today).
- `GeneratorSlotView<'a>`: `pub(crate) fn new(key: GeneratorKey, query: SuggestionQuery, loading: bool, items: &'a [SpecSuggestion]) -> Self` (one bool, distinct types: no swap can compile), accessors `key()`, `query() -> &SuggestionQuery`, `is_loading()` (the name `GeneratorSlot` uses in 6.4e), `items() -> &'a [SpecSuggestion]`. `assemble` reads `!g.is_loading() || *g.query() == SuggestionQuery::Term`, `Some(g.key())`, `g.query().clone()`, `g.items()`.
- engine.rs `reply` (HEAD 1101-1184): `GenView { key: sl.key, query: q.clone(), loading: sl.loading, items: &sl.result }` -> `GeneratorSlotView::new(sl.key, q.clone(), sl.loading, &sl.result)`; the `FilterOpts { .. }` literal -> `FilterOptions::default().with_fuzzy(cur.fuzzy).with_auto_exec_hidden(..).with_exec_after_space(..).with_run_dangerous(..).with_suggest_current_token(..)` with the same expressions in the same order (settings getters are pure); the `InsCtx { .. }` literal -> `InsertionContext::new(<search term>, <raw last token>, <shell>).with_fuzzy(cur.fuzzy).with_prefer_verbose(s.bool(AUTOCOMPLETE_PREFER_VERBOSE_SUGGESTIONS)).with_insert_space(s.bool(AUTOCOMPLETE_INSERT_SPACE_AUTOMATICALLY))`, each bool set explicitly as today.

Tests. No new test. Expected CHANGED against phase6-start (only accessor/builder substitutions with the same values; never a new or dropped assertion):
- first CHANGED here: `partial_sorted_by_score_then_priority` (`x.priority = ..` x3 -> `SuggestionCandidate::new(..).with_priority(..)`), `recency_bands_and_priority_zero` (`list[i].priority = ..` -> `list[i].set_priority(..)`, reads -> `priority()`; it keeps `update_priorities(&mut list, ..)`), `history_rows_priority_and_mixing` (`s.priority`, `rows[0].insert_value` -> accessors), engine.rs `session_update_refreshes_first_token_items` (`s.names[0]` -> `s.names()[0]`, HEAD 1386; the phase doc's 6.3e entry for it is void, recheck R9);
- CHANGED again: `shell_expand_and_directory` (first CHANGED by 6.2b's `i.delete()`/`i.text()` reads; here `main.query = q` -> `with_query(q)`), `bucket_order_and_auto_execute` (`d.is_dangerous = true` -> `with_is_dangerous(true)`; `m.args = ..` twice -> `with_args(..)` on the same row, the second after the first `filter` call as today; `iv.insert_value` -> `with_insert_value`; `FilterOptions { auto_exec_hidden: true, ..opts() }` -> `opts().with_auto_exec_hidden(true)` and the same for `run_dangerous`; `out[0].0.description` -> `description()`), `directory_and_current_token_rows` (the closure's `template_type`/`query` writes -> builders; `original_kind`/`description` reads; the two `FilterOptions { .. }` -> `opts().with_suggest_current_token(true)` / `opts().with_exec_after_space(true)`), `dedupe_only_up_to_50` (`d.display_name =` -> `with_display_name`), `assembly_options_rules` and `option_chain_rewriting` (reads -> accessors), `insertion_examples`, `insertion_review_regressions`, `insertion_round2_regressions` (field writes -> `with_*`; `SuggestionCandidate { names: .., ..SuggestionCandidate::new("", Option) }` -> `SuggestionCandidate::new("", Option).with_names(..)` with the same names; `InsertionContext { insert_space: false, ..ctx(..) }` -> `ctx(..).with_insert_space(false)`, likewise `prefer_verbose`), `item_highlight_and_hint` (`s.names.push("--message")` -> `with_names(vec!["-m".into(), "--message".into()])`, the same final names; `s.args = ..` -> `with_args`; `InsertionContext { fuzzy: true, ..ctx(..) }` -> `ctx(..).with_fuzzy(true)`), `first_token_sources` (`s.kind`, `s.priority`, `items[2].description` -> accessors).
- `should_offer_spec_names_then_aliases_then_executables_each_name_once` (new in 6.2e, not locked) switches to accessors with the same assertions.
- Untouched: `fuzzysort_vectors`, `prefix_ladder`, `empty_search_term_is_no_prefix_match`, `history_rows_skip_multiline_entries`, `help_template`, `list_dir_sorted`, `list_dir_skips_control_char_names`, `triggers`, `cache_ttl_swr_max_age`, the five session-context tests.
Guards: every completion/suggest/engine test (the 6.0a suite included), the menu/render/pty tests, the golden capture.

Traps:
- Every `with_*` and `set_*` writes exactly the field the old assignment wrote, with the same value, at the same point of the computation. In `filter` the auto-execute clone keeps `original_kind = Some(s.kind())` read from the original row, and the folder writes stay inside `if folder`.

- `same_row` still compares `args()` with `Rc::ptr_eq`; never clone the `Arg`s (only the `Vec` of `Rc`s, as today).
- No positional constructor with two bools or two usizes (SUG16, clippy `too_many_arguments` above 7).
- Fields private means: no `pub(crate)` field left on the four VOs (`grep -n 'pub(crate) [a-z_]*:' ` on their files prints nothing).

Evidence a reviewer will rerun: `python3 scripts/hexagonal-refactor/testlock.py . phase6-start --diff` shows only accessor/builder substitutions with unchanged values for the tests above; the diff of `filter`, `update_priorities`, `option_chain`, `mix_history` and `to_item` against the step's start commit shows only field access -> accessor/builder/setter; `grep -n 'pub(crate) [a-z_]*:' src/completion/domain/value_objects/{suggestion_candidate,filter_options,insertion_context,generator_slot_view}.rs` prints nothing; the local fitness run reports nothing for src/completion.

Commits: two (or four), each `refactor(completion): <why>`, each gate-green.

Hands to run 4 (6.4a): the pipeline VOs are private with intention-named builders; services and engine read accessors; suggest.rs still holds only the generator group and its two tests. 6.4e moves `Current.first`/`first_token_cache` (`Vec<SuggestionCandidate>`) into `CompletionSession`; 6.5b's `completion_result_builder.rs` builds `FilterOptions`/`InsertionContext` exactly as `reply` does after this step.

Rules for this step:

Rules for this step:

MISSING must be 0 and DUPLICATE must be 0 in both runs (the gate fails only on MISSING against ef807c1; a DUPLICATE hides one copy of a test from the lock). It must report nothing for src/completion (domain and application above all) or src/terminal_session: completion's domain and application name no legacy module (crate::types, crate::engine, crate::inline, crate::pty, ...), no logger, no anyhow, no serde, no `::infrastructure` path and no other module's use case. A line for a file this step touched is a defect of this step: fix it forward with a new commit. A line for a file this step did not touch is an earlier step's defect: report it, do not hide it. Never commit "completion" in REGISTERED_MODULES (6.7 registers it).
- Clippy allows 3 warnings and the baseline already has 3, so no new warning is allowed: as engine.rs shrinks, delete every `use` it no longer needs (an unused import is a warning); build unit structs as `FsDirectoryLister`, `ApplySessionContextUseCase`, never `::default()` (default_constructed_unit_structs); no fn with more than 7 parameters, self included (too_many_arguments); never rewrite the budget arithmetic with saturating_* (GEN-GT9).
- `grep -n 'cfg(windows)\|cfg(unix)\|cfg(not(\|cfg(target_os\|cfg(all(' ` every file you touch, and check by hand that code under cfg(windows)/cfg(not(unix)) (never compiled here: aarch64-apple-darwin only) still resolves every path from its new place; `cfg!(windows)` expressions compile on every target but their branch logic must stay verbatim.
- Commit as `refactor(completion): <why, not what>` (`test(completion): ...` for a test-only commit). Measure the subject BEFORE committing (`head -1 <msgfile> | awk '{print length}'`): at most 72 characters. Write the message to a file (under target/hexagonal-refactor/msg/) and commit with `git commit -F <file>`, never `-m` (the repo's RTK hook rewrites words inside a -m string); check the subject afterwards with `rtk proxy git log -1 --format=%s`. Stage explicit paths (`git add src docs` is fine; never target/). End every message with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Never rewrite committed history: no `git commit --amend`, rebase, `git reset` of a commit, filter-branch or force. Fix forward with a new commit. A subject over 72 characters is reported, not rewritten.
- `integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped` (shell_integration's embedded_shell_scripts tests) is pty-timing flaky under the gate's parallel load. If it is the gate's only failure, rerun it alone with `cargo test --locked shell_integration::infrastructure::adapters::embedded_shell_scripts::tests::integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped -- --exact` (it must print `1 passed`), then run the full gate again. Never edit, `#[ignore]` or skip it. Any other failing test is a defect of this step.
- Never change behaviour to get green: every log line (text, level, condition, moment), every reply, every file written stays identical. If you cannot keep it, stop at the last green commit, leave the tree clean and report.
- The engine guard: the twelve 6.0a characterization tests run 20 times in a row, `for i in $(seq 20); do cargo test --locked engine::tests -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | grep -q 'test result: ok' || echo "FAIL $i"; done` (confirm the module path first with `cargo test --locked -- --list | grep engine::tests`). Their bodies never change; only their helpers follow an `Engine::with` signature change.
- Run `cargo check --locked --no-default-features --all-targets` before your last commit (should_report_a_build_without_embedded_specs_like_anyhow compiles only there).
- At the end of this step, after the last commit, run `cargo test --locked --release -- --ignored all_bundle_modules` (plan section 8). It must print `1 passed`; report that line.
- Report: the commits (hash + subject), the final gate lines, both testlock summaries, every CHANGED test with its justification, every deviation (including the ones this prompt lists), the block-diff evidence, the fitness result, and concerns for later steps.

Traps (code-cited at HEAD; keep every one):

Rules for this step:
- Move code with a script (python slicing by line ranges, or `git mv` for a whole file), never by retyping it. Record `START=$(git rev-parse HEAD)` before your first edit. Diff every moved block against `git show $START:<old file>` (earlier Phase 6 steps already rewrote these bodies) to prove that only the edits this prompt lists changed, and skim the same block against `git show phase6-start:<old file>` to confirm that nothing beyond the phase's listed edits drifted. Put the block diffs (or their summary) in your report.
- New seams are test-first (xp-tdd): RED, GREEN, commit, REFACTOR, commit. RED for a type or method that does not exist yet is the compile failure of the test written against it. New tests use should_... names that must be unique crate-wide: testlock keys tests by fn name, so `grep -rn "fn <name>(" src` must print nothing before you add one (decision Q22 gives each name one owner). MISSING must be 0 and DUPLICATE must be 0 in both runs (the gate fails only on MISSING against ef807c1; a DUPLICATE hides one copy of a test from the lock). Against phase6-start, every CHANGED test must be one this prompt or an earlier Phase 6 step lists; against ef807c1 only MISSING and DUPLICATE are checked (earlier phases already CHANGED many tests there). Every test this step CHANGED is a pure restructuring: justify each one in changedTests.
- Fitness, locally, after every commit (completion and, since 6.6a, terminal_session exist): copy the committed tree with `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C <dir>` under target/hexagonal-refactor/review-tmp/, add "completion" and "terminal_session" to REGISTERED_MODULES in the copy's src/architecture_tests.rs (it already holds "specs"), run `cargo test --locked architecture` in the copy, then delete the copy. It must report nothing for src/completion (domain and application above all) or src/terminal_session: completion's domain and application name no legacy module (crate::types, crate::engine, crate::inline, crate::pty, ...), no logger, no anyhow, no serde, no `::infrastructure` path and no other module's use case. A line for a file this step touched is a defect of this step: fix it forward with a new commit. A line for a file this step did not touch is an earlier step's defect: report it, do not hide it. Never commit "completion" in REGISTERED_MODULES (6.7 registers it).
- Clippy allows 3 warnings and the baseline already has 3, so no new warning is allowed: as engine.rs shrinks, delete every `use` it no longer needs (an unused import is a warning); build unit structs as `FsDirectoryLister`, `ApplySessionContextUseCase`, never `::default()` (default_constructed_unit_structs); no fn with more than 7 parameters, self included (too_many_arguments); never rewrite the budget arithmetic with saturating_* (GEN-GT9).
- `grep -n 'cfg(windows)\|cfg(unix)\|cfg(not(\|cfg(target_os\|cfg(all(' ` every file you touch, and check by hand that code under cfg(windows)/cfg(not(unix)) (never compiled here: aarch64-apple-darwin only) still resolves every path from its new place; `cfg!(windows)` expressions compile on every target but their branch logic must stay verbatim.
- Commit as `refactor(completion): <why, not what>` (`test(completion): ...` for a test-only commit). Measure the subject BEFORE committing (`head -1 <msgfile> | awk '{print length}'`): at most 72 characters. Write the message to a file (under target/hexagonal-refactor/msg/) and commit with `git commit -F <file>`, never `-m` (the repo's RTK hook rewrites words inside a -m string); check the subject afterwards with `rtk proxy git log -1 --format=%s`. Stage explicit paths (`git add src docs` is fine; never target/). End every message with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Never rewrite committed history: no `git commit --amend`, rebase, `git reset` of a commit, filter-branch or force. Fix forward with a new commit. A subject over 72 characters is reported, not rewritten.
- `integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped` (shell_integration's embedded_shell_scripts tests) is pty-timing flaky under the gate's parallel load. If it is the gate's only failure, rerun it alone with `cargo test --locked shell_integration::infrastructure::adapters::embedded_shell_scripts::tests::integrations_zsh_powerlevel10k_prompt_wrapped -- --exact` (it must print `1 passed`), then run the full gate again. Never edit, `#[ignore]` or skip it. Any other failing test is a defect of this step.
- Never change behaviour to get green: every log line (text, level, condition, moment), every reply, every file written stays identical. If you cannot keep it, stop at the last green commit, leave the tree clean and report.
- The engine guard: the twelve 6.0a characterization tests run 20 times in a row, `for i in $(seq 20); do cargo test --locked engine::tests -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | grep -q 'test result: ok' || echo "FAIL $i"; done` (confirm the module path first with `cargo test --locked -- --list | grep engine::tests`). Their bodies never change; only their helpers follow an `Engine::with` signature change.
- Run `cargo check --locked --no-default-features --all-targets` before your last commit (should_report_a_build_without_embedded_specs_like_anyhow compiles only there).
- At the end of this step, after the last commit, run `cargo test --locked --release -- --ignored all_bundle_modules` (plan section 8). It must print `1 passed`; report that line.
- Report: the commits (hash + subject), the final gate lines, both testlock summaries, every CHANGED test with its justification, every deviation (including the ones this prompt lists), the block-diff evidence, the fitness result, and concerns for later steps.
